tldr: North Node in pisces: growth through surrender, compassion, imagination, and spiritual trust.
body: This nodal axis asks the person to develop surrender, compassion, imagination, and spiritual trust. The South Node in virgo shows the familiar route: perfectionism, analysis, control, and trying to earn rest through flawless usefulness. The work is not to reject the South Node completely, but to stop letting it run automatically. The North Node becomes stronger through repeated, conscious choices to trust the current without giving up discernment.
business: Growth accelerates when the person practices surrender, compassion, imagination, and spiritual trust in real decisions, relationships, work, and daily habits.
shadow: Under stress, the South Node in virgo can pull the person back into perfectionism, analysis, control, and trying to earn rest through flawless usefulness.
policy: Read as a nodal axis: North Node sign names the growth medicine; South Node sign names the familiar pattern. Do not treat either node as a planet or deterministic fate.
note: Distilled from approved project node source material. Source files were not copied into the repository.
